To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the liquisolid technique can be used to formulate matrix tablets for colon delivery of indomethacine.
the liquisolid technique is a suitable method for the formulation of colon-specific drug delivery system of indomethodacin.

the prepared matrix tablets of indomethacine loaded LS system using polysaccharides as carriers and Eudragit® RL 100 as a time-dependent polymer could successfully provide colon-specific drug delivery system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the formulation of a CSDD system of IDM based on E-RL 10 and polysaccharides.
the formulation of matrix tablet for CSDD system of IDM based on E-RL 10 and bacterial degradable polysacharides.
the formulation of matrix CSDD system of indommethacin using bacterial degradable polysacharides as carriers by applying liquisolid technique.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
all the prepared formulations of the study were able to provide an efficient CSDD system.

the combination of polysaccharide-based LS systems and E-RL  100  could  provide  a  CSDD  system  of  IDM  with  a  minimum  shelf  life  of  two  years  and  could  be  used  for the development of a colon-specific drug delivery system of IDM.
PEC-based matrix tablets could serve as a promising CSDD system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
E-RL-100-based tablets containing PEC-based LS systems were able to provide an effective CSDD system of indomethodacin.
PEC-based matrix tablets are the best formulation for colon-specific delivery of indomethacine.
the developed CSDD systems based on polysaccharides and E-RL 10 could be a promising tool for colon targeting of drugs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the liquisolid technique could be successfully used in the formulation of matrix systems for CSDD of IDM.
polysaccharides can be successfully employed in the formulation of colon-specific drug delivery systems by employing the liquisolid technique.
the liquisolid technique could be successfully employed to develop CSDD system for indomethacin.
